0022600164.text: Dallas hosts Sacramento in the Mavericks' seventh game of the 2026-27 season, with the Mavericks at 4-2 on a three-game winning streak and 6th in the West, while the Kings are 0-6 on a six-game losing streak and 15th in the West. The teams have not met yet this season, and their 2025-26 season series ended 2-1 for Sacramento, including a 130-121 Kings win in Dallas on February 26, 2026. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Kyrie Irving is day-to-day with a knee issue and a game-time decision, while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Zach LaVine is day-to-day with elbow soreness and a game-time decision.
